description: Manage working trees that share one Git repository.

categories.name: Options
categories.description: Selected documented options for this command path.

options.detail: Supply a path and optionally a branch or commit. Each linked worktree has its own HEAD and index.

options.summary: List the main and linked worktrees
options.detail: The main worktree appears first, followed by linked worktrees and their branch or detached state.
Removes its files and registration. The main worktree cannot be removed.
Use when the working directory is already gone. For a directory moved by hand, use worktree repair to reconnect it.
